Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting unauthorized proximity to ferry terminals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ferry terminal security; adding a new section tochapter 88.08 RCW; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 88.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person, or vessel, in the water is not allowed within twentyfive yards of a Washington state ferry terminal structure over water,nor is a person allowed beneath a Washington state ferry terminal,unless otherwise authorized by federal, state, or local authorities. (2) Every person who violates this section is guilty of a class 1civil infraction under chapter 7.80 RCW, and may be fined up to onehundred dollars.
